To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

there is wide variability in firm-level corporate governance across countries, and that firm-level corporate goverance is correlated with firm-level operating performance, market valuation and investor protection.

there is wide variability in firm-level governance provisions across countries and across firms within countries, that firm-level governance is highly correlated to country-level investor protection, that firm-level corporate provisions are correlated with better operating and valuation performance, and that firm-level governance provisions matter more for firms operating in countries with weak investor protection.
there is a strong link between firm-level corporate governance and operating performance and that this link is stronger in countries with weaker investor protection laws.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the determinants of investor protection in emerging markets and the link between investor protection and corporate performance.
corporate governance, investor protection, and firm performance in emerging markets.
the link between investor protection and corporate governance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the legal environment of a country is an important determinant of corporate governance, which in turn is an important determinant for firm value.
there is a strong and positive correlation between corporate governance and the quality of investor protection.
the legal environment is important for corporate governance in emerging markets, but that the legal environment and firm-level governance are not necessarily substitutes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we study the link between law, firm-level governance, and firm-level performance in emerging markets.
the quality of investor protection is a critical determinant of corporate governance and that good corporate governance is important for the performance and valuation of firms in emerging markets.
the quality of corporate governance is an important factor in determining firm-level financial performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
corporate governance matters in emerging markets and can be an important determinant of the extent of the financial market development.
firms can improve corporate governance and provide investor protection even in weak legal environments.
firm-level investor protection is important and that firms with better corporate governance perform better.
